note: Baseline for the negative controls. The three composition vectors alone would pass even if branches of the checker were dead: they all reach the same action_linkage and differ only at principal_linkage. Each control mutates ONE input of a committed vector, in memory, and pins the seven rows the checker must then report. No committed vector is modified. Run with tools/run_negative_controls.py.

controls.name: One octet of the AAE-side digest flipped
controls.why: Proves the WHAT-join compares octets rather than prefixes or strings: a single flipped bit in one encoding must be caught. Also proves NOT_EQUIVALENT is reachable, which no committed vector exercises.

controls.name: XP-3's principal given a table entry resolving to a different principal
controls.why: The load-bearing control. Same artifacts, same action digest, one added table entry, and principal_linkage moves UNRESOLVED -> DIVERGENT while evidence_satisfaction moves NOT_EVALUATED -> UNSATISFIED. The two outcomes come from different conditions, not from one condition wearing two labels. Both still end REFUSED at the decision row, which is precisely why the decision row is not the whole result.

controls.name: PSEA proof signature tampered
controls.why: An unauthenticated artifact commits to nothing and its kid claim carries no principal. Proves action_linkage INDETERMINATE is reachable and is a different fact from NOT_EQUIVALENT: C1 establishes that the two sides mean different actions, C3 establishes nothing at all about what the artifact means. The evidence, by contrast, is a definite failure, so it reads UNSATISFIED rather than NOT_EVALUATED.

controls.name: Clock moved past the AAE not_after
controls.why: Proves the native AAE rejection propagates without any downstream row claiming a fact off a grant the verifier just refused. Every row below aae_native reports not-established rather than being omitted or carried over from the unmutated run.

controls.name: Another instant inside both validity windows
controls.why: Positive control. Confirms the four preceding controls fail for their stated reason and not because any perturbation of the inputs refuses.
